reveal_en: Octopuses possess not one, but three hearts. Two hearts circulate blood through their gills, while a larger systemic heart pumps it to the rest of their body. Their blood is also uniquely copper-based and blue.
reveal_zh: 章鱼拥有三颗心脏：两颗为鳃供血，一颗更大的将血液泵向身体其他部位。更奇特的是，它们的血液因铜基蛋白而呈现蓝色。
meaning_en: This unique anatomy reveals how life adapts profoundly to marine environments, optimizing oxygen transport in ways vastly different from our own.
meaning_zh: 这种独特的解剖结构揭示了生命如何为了海洋环境进行深刻适应，以与我们截然不同的方式优化氧气运输。

visual.motion: Pulsating blue light around a central form, subtle tentacle movements.
